seeds.why: Pre-#814 archive._encode_upload_ndjson_single: a direct pgpm.archive_to_s3_ndjson call's lo reaches the object key as the caller spelled it, so archive._object_stem parses it under its own pinned TimeZone and DateStyle while the read parsed it in the caller's session: from a 'SQL, DMY' session '02/01/2024' reads the 2 January rows and PUTs them at the 1 February chunk's key. One clause, the lo's reading. tests/archive/db/54 catches it in parts A, C and D (the object is keyed by another instant than the one the read began at).
